title: export service: Enterprise customer reports failed exports after today's rollout.

hypotheses.title: Configuration error in new export pipeline
hypotheses.rationale: The experimental export pipeline rollout likely introduced a configuration error that is causing export failures specifically for enterprise customers. This could be related to resource allocation, data format handling, or authentication.

hypotheses.title: Code defect in new export pipeline
hypotheses.rationale: A code defect in the new export pipeline could be causing the increased export failures. This could be related to data processing, error handling, or interaction with external dependencies.

hypotheses.title: Resource contention in the export service
hypotheses.rationale: The new export pipeline might be consuming excessive resources (CPU, memory, network) leading to resource contention and export failures, especially under the load of enterprise customers.

hypotheses.title: Dependency issue with a shared service
hypotheses.rationale: The export service relies on a shared service (e.g., database, storage) that is experiencing issues. The rollout might have amplified the impact of these issues, leading to export failures.

recommended_action: Notify the owning team and create a follow-up task.
